name: decision-table
description: Evaluate versioned business decisions and proposed actions with deterministic rules, missing-input semantics, and machine-actionable violations.

interface.shortDescription: Make deterministic decisions from explicit facts.
interface.longDescription: Decision Table gives Codex read-only tools for validating a versioned ruleset, evaluating a business decision, and checking a proposed action. A host-bound constraint.check_approved tool is added when the host supplies an approved ruleset identity; it remains a check because the caller supplies candidate data and facts. Results preserve unknown facts and report the exact ruleset version and fingerprint.
defaultPrompt: Evaluate this decision from the supplied facts.
Validate this ruleset before I use it.
Check whether this proposed action satisfies the constraints.
Check this proposal against the host-approved constraints.
